items.title: Splitting of pure braid monodromy for the double-bubble symplectic plumbing
items.author: Ailsa Keating; Ivan Smith; Michael Wemyss
items.source_version: Official SIGMA22(2026),080; publisher native TeX retrieved2026-10-13; arXiv2601.20438
items.difficulty_reason: The author relates the double-bubble plumbing to a threefold flopping contraction and uses a classification of bounded hearts by the Deligne groupoid. Compact support forces trivial numerical K-theory action, which identifies the relevant pure braid on simple objects; an induction over tilts extends the identification to every heart and proves the retraction is a homomorphism. This uses a different geometry and heart-classification mechanism from the Milnor and marked-surface results.
